description: Get a download URL for the deck as native PowerPoint, PDF, one self-contained HTML file (opens in any browser, no network needed), an mp4 video, or a PNG of one slide (`slide`, 1-based). PowerPoint exports as real editable shapes, text and charts — not pictures of slides. An mp4 takes minutes: the first call starts the render and says how far it is; call again until it says the video is ready. The reply also names what the chosen format drops (the soundtrack, embedded fonts), the same sentences the web editor's export banner shows. Open the link in a browser signed in as this account: the export routes are owner-scoped, and on a free workspace they answer with the server's own unlock message.

slide.description: For png: which slide, 1-based. Defaults to 1.

name: export_deck
title: Export a deck
